support.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

props.name: series
props.description: Series of box plots: data points with `low`, `q1`, `y` (the median), `q3`, `high` and `outliers`

props.name: groups
props.description: Raw samples, one box each (an alternative to `series`)

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the series built from `groups`

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` lays the boxes out in rows

props.name: outlierShape
props.description: Outliers drawn as rings of the series color or as filled dots (series may set their own `outlierShape`)

props.name: outlierSize
props.description: Diameter of the outliers in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: xAxis
props.description: X axis

props.name: yAxis
props.description: Y axis

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name (tap toggles a series)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the finger

props.name: annotations
props.description: Background areas and reference lines

props.name: interaction
props.description: Pinch zoom, pan (drag when zoomed) and double-tap reset; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` tokens, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units `k` / `万`, separators, month and weekday names of time axes). Mini-programs have no `<html lang>`: pass the app language

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: disableScroll
props.description: Keeps the page from scrolling while a finger moves on the chart (needed to pan a zoomed chart or drag points)

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the `<Canvas>` (generated by default)

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the touched (or hovered) points change

events.name: onPointClick
events.description: Called when a point (or bar) is tapped

events.name: onPlotClick
events.description: Called when the plot area is tapped where there is no point

events.name: onZoom
events.description: Called when the user zooms or pans

translationResources.title: Box plot
translationResources.description: Medians, quartiles, whiskers and outliers to compare distributions, from raw samples or computed statistics. Outliers are rings of the series color: hover one to read its value and group.

services.title: Response time per service
services.description: groups takes the raw samples of every box: the quartiles, the whiskers (1.5 interquartile ranges) and the outliers are computed; tooltip.labels translates the rows of the tooltip.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: Statistics already computed (one datum with low, q1, y as the median, q3, high and outliers per box) in rows with orientation: "horizontal".

grouped.title: Grouped
grouped.description: boxplotData turns samples into box plot data: one series per period, the boxes of each city side by side.

temperatures.title: With a line
temperatures.description: boxplotStats gives the five numbers and the mean of each month: whisker: "minmax" extends the whiskers to the extremes and a line joins the means.

build-times.title: Whisker rules
build-times.description: CI build durations per pipeline. whisker sets how far the whiskers reach (1.5 or 3 interquartile ranges, or "minmax" for no outliers), and outlierShape and outlierSize change how the slow runs are drawn; boxplotStats with the same rule counts them.

wait-times.title: Click a box or an outlier
wait-times.description: Emergency room waits per weekday. onPointClick receives the median, q1, q3 and the number of outliers of the clicked box, or the value of the clicked outlier in item.outlier; on the category axis, event.x is the index of the day.

asset-sizes.title: Log scale
asset-sizes.description: File sizes from a few kilobytes to tens of megabytes: yAxis.type: "log" keeps every box readable, while on a linear axis the small files are crushed against zero. The format switches from kB to MB and a line marks the size budget.

live-regions.title: Live latency per region
live-regions.description: Every second a setInterval (cleared on pause and unmount) slides a window over the latest requests of each region. The color of a group turns red when its third quartile exceeds the SLA line, and the y axis range is fixed so the boxes stay comparable.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Raw response times per service: the quartiles, whiskers and outliers are computed; the tooltip rows are written in the language of locale.

BoxPlotChartProps.series: Series of box plots: points with low, q1, y (the median), q3, high and outliers (see boxplotData / boxplotStats)
BoxPlotChartProps.groups: Raw samples, one box each (an alternative to series)
BoxPlotChartProps.name: Name of the series built from groups
BoxPlotChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" lays the boxes out in rows
BoxPlotChartProps.outlierShape: Outliers drawn as rings of the series color (hollow) or as filled dots; series may set their own outlierShape
BoxPlotChartProps.outlierSize: Diameter of the outliers in CSS pixels

BoxplotGroup.values: Raw values: their quartiles, whiskers and outliers are computed
BoxplotGroup.color: Color of the box (any CSS color)

BoxplotStats.low: Lower whisker: the smallest value within reach
BoxplotStats.high: Upper whisker: the largest value within reach

BoxplotStatsOptions.whisker: Reach of the whiskers in interquartile ranges beyond the box (Tukey: 1.5); "minmax" extends them to the extremes (no outliers)

ChartTooltipLabels.open: Name of the opening price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.high: Name of the highest price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.low: Name of the lowest price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.close: Name of the closing price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.max: Name of the upper whisker row (box plots)
ChartTooltipLabels.q3: Name of the third quartile row
ChartTooltipLabels.q1: Name of the first quartile row
ChartTooltipLabels.min: Name of the lower whisker row (box plots)
ChartTooltipLabels.outliers: Name of the number of outliers
ChartTooltipLabels.value: Name of the value of bubbles when the series has no valueName

services.title: Response times per service
services.description: Raw samples per service: quartiles, Tukey whiskers and outliers are computed by the chart.

horizontal.title: Horizontal boxes, min-max whiskers
horizontal.description: Boxes laid out in rows; whiskers reaching the minimum and the maximum (no outliers).

props.valueName: Name of the value in the tooltip
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
